scope: Three quiet serialized CPU pairs, order before/after, after/before, before/after. No native renderer or regression processes concurrent. CPU timings exclude renderer and are not player FPS.

before.scope: Headless fixed-step CPU only, production player/combat methods; durable actors and production-fired projectile floor; no renderer, mission director, audio playback, or UI. Sustaining injection is untimed. Effects are retained and expire normally.
